name: Basmati Rice
siboNotes: Well-tolerated rice variety that's gentle on the digestive system and provides easily digestible carbohydrates for SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Rinse thoroughly before cooking to remove excess starch
Use a 1:1.5 rice to water ratio for fluffy texture
Let rest 5 minutes after cooking before fluffing with fork
Store leftovers properly and reheat thoroughly to prevent bacterial growth
